description:
We're  looking for a   Technology and Innovation  BUSINESS DEVELOPER   to join our sales team in Granada, Spain.   

 
   

 The company :   

 S afran Electronics and  Defense  (SED) , and particularly  SED Spain  is world  leader in Resilient Positioning, Navigation and Timing (R-PNT) solutions that improve the reliability, performance and safety of critical applications, and high-risk operations, even in GPS/GNSS denied environments. We provide  virtually fail-safe  GNSS and PNT solutions for  defense ,  aerospace  and commercial applications worldwide.   

 W e are a highly dynamic company with a clear focus on research and innovation programs for providing reliable solutions that have robust, dependable, and reliable timing at their core.     

 We collaborate closely  with agencies such as  ESA ,  the European Commission  and  Defense  Agencies , as well as with  international partners in the framework of   institutional and commercial  Aerospace,  Defense  and Science programs .   

 W e are looking for a   Te chnology and Innovation  Business Develop er   contributing to growth our business  in the indicated  application segments .     

  
 What  you’ll  be doing as Technology and Innovation Business Developer:   

 You will have responsibility for seeking and engaging new business opportunities  mainly  in Space (through ESA, national delegations and companies in this segment), Aerospace (avionics, drones, and other vehicles),  large scientific facilities (such as particle accelerators or radioastronomy) and  Defense  at an international level leveraging also other contacts and international network of Safran  Electronics and  Defense   group.    

 As a key member of our Research & Technology and Programs teams :   

 
 Y ou will  facilitate   our  engagement in  national/ international business opportunities contributing to the company growth    

 
 
 You will increase market penetration by understanding the competitive market landscape, how and where Safran Electronics &  Defense  technology can be of use   

 
 
 You will p romote and lead long-term commercial partnerships with key customers  and partnerships   in  Aerospace ,  Defense  and  Science  programs   

 
 
 You will work on identifying /qualifying/pursuing  business opportunities aligned with the   company technologies   

 
 
 You will c ollaborate on project proposals from a business development perspective, providing ad hoc support as  required   

 
 
 You will  l everag e  strategic partnerships to enhance performance, including preparation of international complex consortia and conducting joint international calls   

 
 
 You are expected to  maintain  up-to-date internal databases related to customers, opportunities, and commercial activities   

 
   

 What Success Looks Like:   

 
 Exceed annual order plan for R&T projects  and  programs   

 
 
 Execute on plans to increase  business opportunities  aligned with the company strategy  and  R&T technology roadmap   

 
 
 Develop and enhance customer  long-term  relationships such that Safran Electronics &  Defense  is viewed as a partner to our customers   

 
   

 Knowledge, Skills & Abilities  We’re  Looking For:   

 
 A proven  track record  of exceeding business targets  in  Aerospace,  Defense  and Science programs .   

 
 
 Interpersonal skills to develop relationships with customers and partners   

 
 
 Team player with excellent communication and presentation skills   

 
 
 Ability to communicate technical ideas and write abstracts   

 
 
 Fast learner with strong grasp of  new technologies  and programs   

 
 
 Self-starter, confident, committed, and enthusiastic   

 
 
 Ability to take initiative, multi-task and prioritize   

 
 
 Proficient in prospecting, negotiating, and closing   

 
 
 Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.   

 
 
 Ability to work at international level   

 
   

 Requirements:   

 
 Background in a Technical education or Engineering discipline   

 
 
 5 + years of business development experience with relevant electronic products, ideally in  Aerospace,  Defense  and Science programs .   

 
 
 Knowledge of how International, European, and National program and grant systems  operate  is highly  advantageous .   

 
 
 Plus: experience with Position, Navigation,  Timing  and/or Simulation products   

 
 
 This role requires intensive international travels .    

 
 Note:  If you have interest in the position, consider applying for it even  if you  don’t  meet 100% of the requirements. Apply, learn about our proposal, and show us what you can bring!   

   

   

 What we offer:   

   

 
 Flexible working conditions, including  full  remote work policies and adaptable schedules to support work-life balance.   

 
 
 Comprehensive benefits package, including a flexible  remuneration  plan (meal cards, private medical insurance, childcare vouchers, etc.), life and accident insurance.   

 
   

 Safran Electronics &  Defense  is an equal opportunity employer who does not discriminate based on race,  color , religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any protected category.  We encourage veterans and people with disabilities to apply.
